title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. not seen practicing Monday
items.desc: Michael Pittman Jr. was not seen in uniform at practice on Monday.
items.impact: Steelers coach Mike McCarthy said Pittman got banged up in Saturday's practice. There will be an update on his status when available.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DK Metcalf not seen practicing Monday
items.desc: DK Metcalf was not seen in uniform in Monday's practice.
items.impact: Metcalf was not in team periods at the end of Saturday's practice. There should be an update on his status when available.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cyrus Allen participates in 11-on-11s Monday
items.desc: Cyrus Allen returned to participating in 11-on-11s on Monday.
items.impact: It was the first time in training camp both Allen and Rashee Rice participated in 11-on-11s on the same day.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Matthew Golden (toe) not expected to practice Monday
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said he does not expect WR Matthew Golden to practice on Monday.
items.impact: Golden also missed practice on Sunday. He remains day-to-day. It is unknown how serious his injury is.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jayden Reed (ankle) not expected to practice Monday
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said he does not expect WR Jayden Reed to practice on Monday.
items.impact: Reed also missed practice on Sunday. He remains day-to-day. It is unknown how serious his injury is.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Makai Lemon (hamstring) still not practicing Monday
items.desc: Makai Lemon remained absent from practice on Monday.
items.impact: Lemon has been sidelined for close to a week due to a hamstring injury. The rookie continues to work his way back to full health.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Laremy Tunsil (torn triceps) will undergo surgery
items.desc: Commanders coach Dan Quinn said Laremy Tunsil will undergo surgery to repair his torn triceps.
items.impact: Tunsil suffered a torn triceps on Saturday. There should be a better sense of his timeline after the surgery. He is expected to miss most of the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Caedan Wallace waived by Patriots
items.desc: The Patriots waived OT Caedan Wallace.
items.impact: Wallace was the No. 68 overall pick of New England in the 2024 NFL Draft. He will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Terrion Arnold to visit with Saints
items.desc: Terrion Arnold will visit with the Saints.
items.impact: Arnold met with the Seahawks on Sunday and the Texans previously. His legal situation remains unclear, but he is drawing interest from teams for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cade Mays (wrist) to miss 'significant amount of time'
items.desc: Lions coach Dan Campbell said C Cade Mays will miss a "significant amount of time."
items.impact: Detroit signed Mays to a three-year, $25 million contract this offseason. It is a brutal blow as he is expected to miss 8-10 weeks after fracturing a small bone in his wrist. It is not expected to be season-ending.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) not practicing Monday
items.desc: DeVonta Smith is not practicing on Monday.
items.impact: Smith has been sidelined from practice for the past week. His status will need to continue to be monitored this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Isiah Pacheco dealing with sprained MCL, should be good to go Week 1
items.desc: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Isiah Pacheco is dealing with a sprained MCL but should be good to go in time for Week 1.
items.impact: "We feel pretty good about him being ready to go, especially when the season gets here," Campbell said. Pacheco is slated to open the season backing up Jahmyr Gibbs.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Hunter Henry agrees to two year extension with Patriots
items.desc: Hunter Henry has agreed to a two year extension with the New England Patriots. He had one year left remaining on his contract, but is now locked in till the end of 2028.
items.impact: It's great news for Henry managers, but bad news for Eli Raridon truthers. The rookie and promising young tight end could still break out as Henry ages out, but this certainly puts a damper on his prospects in the short term. But getting back to Henry, he should be a solid target later in fantasy drafts this year.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: David Blay Jr. waived by Patriots
items.desc: The Patriots waived rookie DT David Blay Jr.
items.impact: Blay will figure to seek another opportunity. New England signed safety Eric Butler as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Eric Butler signs with Patriots
items.desc: The Patriots signed safety Eric Butler.
items.impact: Butler is an undrafted rookie out of San Diego State. He will compete for a depth role in the Patriots secondary.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dallis Flowers (leg) placed on IR
items.desc: The Bears placed DB Dallis Flowers on injured reserve.
items.impact: Flowers went down in practice earlier this week. He will likely miss the upcoming season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Woods signs with Bears
items.desc: The Bears signed DB Xavier Woods.
items.impact: Woods spent last season with the Titans. He totaled 39 tackles and two interceptions across 11 games played with 10 starts.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jamon Johnson signs with Ravens
items.desc: The Ravens signed LB Jamon Johnson.
items.impact: Johnson signed with the Packers after going undrafted last year. He will compete for a depth role in the Ravens linebacker room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Garrett DiGiorgio (foot) placed on IR
items.desc: The Jaguars placed OL Garrett DiGiorgio on injured reserve.
items.impact: DiGiorgio went down in practice in late July.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Geron Christian Sr. signs with Jaguars
items.desc: The Jaguars signed OL Geron Christian Sr.
items.impact: Christian did not appear in any games for the Cowboys or Broncos last season. He'll compete for a depth role on the Jaguars offensive line.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Matthew McDoom waived by Ravens
items.desc: The Ravens waived CB Matthew McDoom.
items.impact: McDoom will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Power Echols waived by Seahawks
items.desc: The Seahawks waived LB Power Echols.
items.impact: Echols signed with Seattle earlier this week. He'll figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Justin Jones signs with Seahawks
items.desc: The Seahawks signed RB Justin Jones.
items.impact: Jones will compete for a depth role at running back and on special teams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jack Stonehouse waived by Texans
items.desc: The Texans waived punter Jack Stonehouse.
items.impact: Stonehouse went undrafted this year. The move leaves Kai Kroeger as the only punter on the roster for Houston.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Owen Wright signs with Texans
items.desc: The Texans signed RB Owen Wright.
items.impact: Wright played in three games for the Bucs last season. He will compete for a role in the backfield and on special teams for Houston.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyrese Rowan signs with Broncos
items.desc: The Broncos signed WR Kyrese Rowan.
items.impact: Rowan was an undrafted free agent last year. He will compete for a depth role in the Broncos wide receiver room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ricardo Hallman signs with Broncos
items.desc: The Broncos signed CB Ricardo Hallman.
items.impact: Hallman went undrafted in the NFL Draft this year. He will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sam Webb released by Broncos
items.desc: The Broncos released DB Sam Webb.
items.impact: Webb had signed with Denver in late July. He'll figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Matt Henningsen (Achilles) placed on IR
items.desc: The Broncos placed OL. Matt Henningsen on injured reserve.
items.impact: Henningsen tore his Achilles at practice this week. He will miss the upcoming season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Parker Romo works out for Titans
items.desc: The Titans hosted kicker Parker Romo for a workout.
items.impact: Romo was one of three kickers to try out for Tennessee. He connected on 11-of-14 field goals for the Falcons last season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: John Hoyland works out for Titans
items.desc: The Titans hosted free agent kicker John Hoyland for a workout.
items.impact: Hoyland was one of three kickers to try out for Tennessee. He spent the spring in the UFL.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Younghoe Koo works out for Titans
items.desc: The Titans hosted free agent kicker Younghoe Koo.
items.impact: Koo was one of three kickers to try out for Tennessee. He made 6-of-9 field goal attempts across six games for the Giants and Falcons last season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Timothy McKay waived by Commanders
items.desc: The Commanders waived OL Timothy McKay.
items.impact: McKay will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Hilton Jr. waived by Commanders
items.desc: The Commanders waived WR Chris Hilton Jr.
items.impact: Hilton will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DJ Davidson placed on reserve/retired list
items.desc: The Commanders placed DT D.J. Davidson on the reserve/retired list.
items.impact: Davidson signed a one-year contract with the Commanders in March. He was a fifth-round selection of the Giants in the 2022 NFL Draft.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nicholas Petit-Frere signs with Commanders
items.desc: The Commanders signed OL Nicholas Petit-Frere.
items.impact: Petit-Frere started 28 of the 34 games he played for the Titans. He'll add depth on the offensive line for Washington.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Daniel Brunskill signs with Commanders
items.desc: The Commanders signed OL Daniel Brunskill.
items.impact: Brunskill played in 16 games with five starts for the Dolphins last season. He will add depth on the Commanders offensive line.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenny Yeboah placed on IR
items.desc: The Cardinals placed TE Kenny Yeboah on injured reserve.
items.impact: Yeboah suffered a hamstring injury in the Hall of Fame Game on Thursday night. He will likely miss the entirety of the upcoming season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joey Blount placed on IR
items.desc: The Cardinals placed S Joey Blount on injured reserve.
items.impact: Blount was injured during practice this week. It is the second straight season-ending he has suffered.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Luther Burden III (groin) expected to miss about one month
items.desc: Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports reports that the Bears are expecting Luther Burden III to miss about a month.
items.impact: The Bears are hopeful Burden will be back and available for Chicago's season opener against the Panthers. It originally seemed like he may only miss a week or two, but now this is pushing him to being sidelined right until Week 1. Fantasy managers with drafts coming up in redraft leagues will want to be cautious with Burden.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trevon Diggs works out for Lions
items.desc: The Lions worked out free agent CB Trevon Diggs this weekend.
items.impact: Diggs appeared in eight games with the Cowboys and one game for the Packers last season. It is unclear if he is drawing interest from any other team.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zavion Thomas leaves practice early Sunday
items.desc: Bears rookie WR Zavion Thomas left Sunday's practice early with an apparent knee injury.
items.impact: Hope notes that Thomas "briefly grabbed his knee and then walked off with a slight limp." Thomas was a third-round pick for Chicago this year.

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.title: Joshua Dobbs signs 1-year deal with Lions
items.desc: Joshua Dobbs is signing a 1-year, $1.425 million contract with the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Dobbs will likely slide into the backup quarterback role in Detroit after Teddy Bridgewater announced he would be stepping away from the team. Dobbs was in New England for four games last season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Downs (groin) could return to practice Tuesday
items.desc: Colts coach Shane Steichen said Josh Downs could potentially return for Tuesday's joint practice at New England.
items.impact: Downs missed a second straight practice on Sunday, but Steichen clarified that it is not considered serious. He could be back on the field as soon as Tuesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Haynes King (hamstring) will not play Saturday
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said Haynes King will not play on Saturday against the Bills.
items.impact: Canales reiterated that King strained his hamstring on his winning touchdown run in the Hall of Fame game. He is considered week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zay Flowers (quad) not expected to be sidelined long
items.desc: Ravens coach Jesse Minter told reporters on Sunday that Zay Flowers won't be sidelined very long.
items.impact: Flowers suffered a quad contusion during practice on Saturday. "I feel really good about where that's at," Minter said. "It may take a couple days. It may take one day, three days. I feel good that he'll be back out there being Zay pretty soon."
